## This session discovery method
1. Harvested candidate `/article/` IDs from `so.toutiao.com/search` and `m.toutiao.com/search` HTML for creator-name / title queries (multiple offsets).
2. Cross-checked each ID via public `m.toutiao.com/i{id}/info/v2/` — required matching `media_id` or exact `media_user.screen_name` (`温义飞的急救财经` / `小Lin说` / `半佛仙人本仙人`).
3. Converted API `content` HTML → plain text; required ≥200 non-space chars after stripping image placeholders; skipped pure video / wrong-author / short bodies.
4. Wrote `transcripts/{id}.txt` + `raw/{id}.json`, appended `corpus_index.csv`, appended `b2_text_manifest.csv`.
